user.title: Connect to SA Power Networks
user.description: Sign in to the SAPN meter-data portal. Credentials are stored by Home Assistant and sent only to SAPN.

meters.title: Choose meters
meters.description: Select the SAPN meters to import. Home Assistant will inspect a recent 14-day sample to find each meter's NEM12 channels.

channels.title: Name meter channels
channels.description: Every discovered channel is kept separate. Give each channel a useful name and choose whether it represents grid consumption, return to grid, or should be ignored. {discovery_result}

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the SAPN portal.
error.no_nmis: No NMIs were assigned to this SAPN account.
error.channel_discovery: The selected meters' channels could not be inspected. Try again.

abort.already_configured: This SAPN account is already configured.

init.title: SA Power Networks Meter Data options
init.description: Choose which SAPN meters are imported. Their recent NEM12 channels will be inspected on the next step.

channels.title: Name meter channels
channels.description: Rename or reclassify each channel. Existing statistic IDs remain based on the NMI and channel code. {discovery_result}

error.cannot_connect: Could not refresh the NMIs from the SAPN portal. Saved NMIs are still available.
error.channel_discovery: The selected meters' channels could not be inspected. Try again.
